name: Construções Carlos Pinho, Lda.
verdict: Self-owned Arouca construction company (Sociedade por Quotas, EUR 500,000 capital). Nothing found.
note: Rated during the Arouca research (issue #386): back-of-shirt sponsor at FC Arouca in 2026-27, and the club's main shirt sponsor for more than a decade before bwin took over in July 2026.
